- Aug 14: `Worker launched … It will complete in the background and notify automatically.`

Droid's `PostToolUse` now fires when the *launch call returns*, not when the Worker *finishes*. Our handler at `cmd/entire/cli/lifecycle.go:1198` therefore sees an unchanged worktree and skips.

The work isn't lost, but it's **misattributed**. The Worker now runs as its own full droid session (own SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop), so its file lands as an ordinary session checkpoint:

git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
fix(factoryai-droid): attribute Worker sessions to their parent task

Droid changed Worker dispatch from blocking to background. Its PostToolUse
hook now fires when the Worker is *launched* rather than when it finishes —
~3s after PreToolUse, against an untouched worktree — so SubagentEnd found no
file changes and skipped the task checkpoint every time.

The work was not lost, but it was misattributed. A Droid Worker runs as a full
session of its own, so its file write was captured by the ordinary turn-end
path and landed on the shadow branch under the Worker's own session ID, at
.entire/metadata/<worker-session>/ instead of
.entire/metadata/<parent>/tasks/<tool-use-id>/. Subagent work therefore
surfaced as a top-level session the user never drove.

Key the attribution off data Droid persists rather than off hook ordering: a
Worker's transcript records callingSessionId and callingToolUseId on its
session_start line. Turn-end consults the new optional SubagentSessionResolver
capability and, for a subagent session, writes a task checkpoint on the parent
instead of a session checkpoint of its own. This holds whether dispatch is
synchronous or asynchronous, and does not depend on the synthetic tool-use IDs
the CLI mints when Droid's tool hooks omit one.

Claude Code deliberately does not implement the capability — its subagents
block the parent turn, so the existing SubagentEnd path already bounds them.

Fixes the two E2E tests failing on main since 2026-08-12:
TestFactoryTaskCheckpointExistsBeforeCommit and
TestFactoryCommittedCheckpointExcludesPreExistingUntrackedFiles.
